generalEvidence: Page heading "Endorsements in the Year 2026"; entries already decided earlier in 2026 are marked "– won"/"– lost" and LA City races going to November are marked "– run-off". Unmarked entries are for races on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot (e.g. Burbank, Lynwood, West Hollywood councils); matching press releases are dated October 2026 (e.g. "LALCV Endorses Arellano, Muñoz-Guevara and Watkins for Lynwood City Council" – October 12, 2026). CAVEAT: the page itself never says "November"; won/lost entries were excluded.
whyItCounts: Pro-environment political group that "supports pro-environmental candidates throughout Los Angeles County" (separate from California Environmental Voters).

CONFLICT: Current page lists Maria Gutzeit as '(Division 3)', but her press release dated September 28, 2026 says 'Director, Division 4, Santa Clarita Valley Water Agency' (https://lalcv.org/lalcv-endorses-maria-gutzeit-for-director-division-4-santa-clarita-valley-water-agency/). Dated posts for LACCD (Veres Sept 27, Winston Sept 23, Pearlman Oct 17, 2026) and PACCD (Kwong, Gibson, Pollara/Baum Sept 29, 2026) support the general-election timing.

verify.note: Page 'Endorsements in the Year 2026' (fetched with curl; Chrome has no read permission on lalcv.org). It mixes June primary results (marked won/lost, not transcribed) with pending November races; the transcribed entries are the unmarked ones plus LA City CD3 and CD9 marked 'run-off'. All 60 list entries and the two Foothill MWD posts (Sept 28, 2026) confirmed. The page spells 'Juan Muños-Guevara' while LALCV's own Oct 12 news headline spells 'Muñoz-Guevara'; kept the page spelling, match against the ballot name. LALCV's Gutzeit post says Division 4, but the list page says Division 3 and the county contest list has Division 3 (vote for 2), so Division 3 kept.
